level: Source analysis and proposed UI acceptance scenarios; not new implementation or live verification
preserved: Accepted events list remains unchanged; no publication, server writes, or product status changes

evidence.versionLimit: Exported source directory is not a Git checkout; exact source hashes recorded separately. Published .ru baseline 7c23466 is a separate reference, not proof these exported sources are the active bundle.

coverageRule: Scenario families below combine orthogonally: event lifecycle × access × data availability × ticket/financial state × editing/save state × navigation/device. This is a finite acceptance matrix, not a claim to enumerate every possible combination.
common: Loading without briefly exposing cached owner data
Sign-in/return path; no private metrics or mutation
Header/back remains usable; no invented zero values
Retry; distinguish from absent event internally without leaking ownership
No management actions; no existence disclosure through private content
Separate read visibility and mutation permissions; server policy authoritative
Incomplete/invalid legacy dates or unknown status
Known data only; explicit uncertainty, no invented live/approval
Long title, failed/missing cover, large numbers
Fallback cover, wrapping, precise money and full values
Return to events; successful save restores selected tab/position when possible
currentWorkspace: Date/place/status, countdown to start, tickets/revenue; no arrived count
Transition to live without losing workspace state
Live status and arrived count; no time remaining to end, per accepted decision
Transition to archive/read-only; stop mutation affordances
Continue editing; distinguish incomplete data from loading failure; no fictitious sales
Status and honest permitted actions; cannot self-approve
Status/reason if delivered; existing tickets retained; no fake resubmission success
Different empty states; no ticket creation shortcut unless actual route supports it
Registrations versus paid ticket revenue; mixed is not globally Free
Sold out / unlimited / sales not started or closed
Different sales states from event lifecycle; no sales progress bar
Metrics loading, unavailable, stale or mismatched event
Keep event available; local retry; unavailable is not zero
Only confirmed money adjustments; never equate ticket revenue and payout
Open private list or editor; do not imply public guest disclosure
Scanner entry gated by current organizer permissions and nonarchived status
editor: Editable fields only after trustworthy read; retry instead of initializing blanks
Different save state; unchanged form must not accidentally alter review status
Continue editing or explicitly discard; no claimed server/local draft persistence without implementation
Valid draft versus valid publish request
Separate Save changes and review submission semantics; preserve existing pending/removed status unless explicit supported transition
Inline message, focus target, no clearing other fields
Calendar validation and timezone; prevent silent date rollover
Unknown duration explicit; overnight end shows next date
Multi-day event / equal start and end
Do not collapse original end date into next-day time; actual source currently only edits end time
Past start, live, or event ends during edit
Recheck persisted lifecycle; cannot reopen archived event by changing dates
Reflect actual server publishing requirements; do not invent universal 18+ or stricter draft requirements
Cover unchanged / newly selected / picker cancelled
Cancel preserves prior cover and form
Cover access denied / invalid file / upload failure
Explain recoverable issue, preserve prior cover, retry
Prevent duplicate save; failed update must not replace/remove live cover
Success with published / pending / draft server response
Show actual returned status; refresh workspace, not assumed publication
Keep user values; unknown result needs readback before repeating side effects
Detect/reload/resolve conflict without silently overwriting another version
Session or edit permission lost during save
No success claim; safe recovery and re-read permissions
Publish visibility toggle with existing tickets
Unpublish is not cancellation or refunds; explain consequences and confirm intent
Review impact; approved re-review/notification/refund policy remains an open dependency, not an invented automatic mailing
Clarify who can see data; not a consent substitute or automatic public list
Zero permitted only if allocation permits; distinguish no sales and unavailable quantities
Quota invalid / below allocated / allocations changed concurrently
Explain total limit versus remaining; authoritative server rejection retained
Quota dirty / saving / saved / failed / access denied
Separate save result from main form; show which changes are already committed
Not supported by current editor; do not expose fake price save or ticket-type creation
Dirty-state and in-flight result policy; no sensitive persistent draft by default
Narrow screen, keyboard, zoom, validation focus
Fields/buttons remain visible and labelled; preserve tab/focus and values
archiveWorkspace: Uniform read-only date/status/tickets/ticket revenue; no arrived count per selected archive design
Same archive structure, cancellation status; not treated as ordinary completed event
Free event / zero sales / mixed types
Honest metric labels and genuine zeros, no invented payment or payout
Preserve historical event and reconcile money; do not conflate gross issued tickets with active tickets
Archive is read-only for event details, not a guarantee financial facts are final
Retry in place; retain known details, never 0 by default
Fallbacks; reconcile existing six-hour archive rule before integration
Read-only block and route to archive workspace; no date-based reopening
Only existing allowed read routes; preserve privacy and event public visibility constraints
Scanner / edit / publish / delete / duplicate requests
No scanner/edit/publish/delete in archive; duplication is a proposal only, not existing functionality

sourceFindings.observed: Missing endsAt uses start + six hours; cancelled or hasEnded is archived
sourceFindings.conflict: Accepted local list uses explicit unknown when end is absent
sourceFindings.next: Reconcile with actual server sales/end contract before integration; do not modify accepted snapshot or server rule silently

sourceFindings.observed: Read errors are logged but represented as null like not found/no access; editor has no dedicated read retry
sourceFindings.next: Distinct internal load state and safe generic unavailable/retry UI

sourceFindings.observed: pending/removed initialize false; saving passes draft when false
sourceFindings.risk: Ordinary edit can request a lifecycle transition unintentionally
sourceFindings.next: Explicit status transition and save-content semantics, preserving moderation authority

sourceFindings.observed: saveEvent returns actual status; caller goes back without displaying it
Original end date is discarded; end time interpreted as same or following day, including equal times as next day
sourceFindings.risk: Multi-day event can shorten accidentally during unrelated edit
sourceFindings.next: Preserve original end timestamp when unchanged; explicit end date for multi-day editing

sourceFindings.observed: Client validates title/date/cover/description/age, but not venue; server error description includes venue
sourceFindings.next: Align visible publishing validation with actual versioned contract; drafts separate

sourceFindings.observed: No dirty exit/version conflict/uncertain save result UI; quota rows persist independently
sourceFindings.next: Unsaved-exit, unknown result, conflict and independent quota-save states

sourceFindings.observed: Existing workspace shows attendance and sales progress even for archive; published time-derived live not separated in status rendering
sourceFindings.next: Apply accepted state-based visual decisions in new concept; not implemented by this analysis

legalScope.PD-07,RT-005: DOC: preserve private guest-list visibility; no assumption a toggle grants consent or public disclosure

designRecommendation: Two reusable layouts: lifecycle-aware event workspace (current and archive variants), and editor with explicit mutation state; three review entry points. Keep accepted list unchanged. Do not add new notifications, automatic refunds, duplicate, deletion, or payout flows without agreed requirements.
